title: Getting started
summary: Get the launcher ready to join a Burning Empires server.

sections.heading: What you need
steps: Subscribe to Bannerlord Coop on the Steam Workshop.
Download Burning Empires 2.0.2 from Nexus Mods, the main file and the hotfix. Leave both downloads as they are.
sections.tip: The launcher looks for both Burning Empires downloads on your PC, so Downloads is fine.

sections.heading: Set up the game
steps: Click Check mods. It looks for every module of your setup and does not download anything.
On the Settings page, click Install or repair Burning Empires. It puts in the main file, then the hotfix, then Burning Empires Coop Compat.
Installing by hand? Install the main file first, then the hotfix.
It also subscribes you to Harmony, ButterLib and UIExtenderEx on the Steam Workshop when one is missing. MCM comes from Nexus Mods.
sections.tip: Install or repair never deletes Burning Empires or your Burning Empires saves. It only writes the new files over the old ones.

sections.heading: Good to know
steps: Pick your language with the 🌐 button at the bottom of the sidebar.
The War Sails variant and the Historical campaign start do not work in Coop.
When an update is out, a bar at the top shows Install update.
Click What's new next to the language button to see what changed in the last few versions.
